hero_before.message: Open any model on MakerWorld and press

hero_after.message: . The file comes out ready for your printer and slicer.

prefs_intro.message: You decide what stays from the designer's tuning and what comes from your printer. These apply to every download.

keep_hint.message: Off means your printer profile wins.

pref_temps_desc.message: Nozzle and bed temperatures and density set by the designer, on top of your filament profile.

pref_cooling_desc.message: Fan and cooling values set by the designer, instead of your profile.

pref_cooling_warn.message: A percentage means a different airflow on each printer. A stronger fan can over-cool (weak layers, warping in PETG/ABS); a weaker one can under-cool (sagging overhangs and bridges). Use it only when the model's cooling is essential.

pref_cooling_advice.message: unless the designer says the cooling is key, e.g. for long bridges or a print-in-place part.

pref_cooling_row3.message: Fan off for first N layers

pref_tuning_desc.message: Accelerations, elephant foot, XY compensation, first-layer flow, arc fitting and the G-code file name.

pref_tuning_warn_title.message: These values belong to the designer's machine

pref_tuning_warn.message: Accelerations follow the source printer's motion system, and calibration values (elephant foot, XY compensation, first-layer flow) were measured on that machine, not yours.

pref_tuning_advice.message: when you know what you're doing, e.g. you've checked these values suit your printer or you want to try the designer's tuning.

assign_intro.message: Multicolor models come with a plan: which color goes in which slot of your AMS or multi-material unit. This decides who has the final say, the file or your slicer.

assign_compatible_desc.message: The file keeps the model's colors, and your slicer matches them to your spools when you open it. Works in every slicer.

assign_compatible_when.message: you're not sure. It never blocks a file.

assign_exact_desc.message: Each color arrives locked to a slot, exactly as the designer planned. Some slicers refuse files like this.

assign_exact_when.message: your spools are loaded in the same order as the designer's plan.

assign_slicer_desc.message: Exact when your slicer accepts it, Compatible when it doesn't. Decided for you on each download.

assign_slicer_when.message: you want Exact but switch between slicers.

assign_example_compatible.message: You match it in the slicer

convert_intro.message: For a .3mf you already have, like a Bambu Studio project. Not needed for MakerWorld.

onboarding_1_hint.message: Pick one to start. You can add more later.

onboarding_2_hint.message: We picked the most common one. Change only what's different on yours.

setup_prefs_note.message: Conversion preferences start with safe defaults. You can fine-tune them any time.

onboarding_3_text.message: From now on, open any model on MakerWorld and use the new download button. That's it.

onboarding_pin_tip.message: Tip: pin PrintNomad in Chrome's toolbar to come back here.

mw_note_tuning.message: Printer tuning taken from your profile

add_hint.message: Pick it and it's added. You can change its setup right after.
